_source.site: CDC WONDER (wonder.cdc.gov), National Center for Health Statistics mortality databases
_source.method: WONDER XML API (POST https://wonder.cdc.gov/controller/datarequest/{dataset}, parameter request_xml plus accept_datause_restrictions=true), sent from the built-in browser on wonder.cdc.gov at least 15 s apart (WONDER's API rate limit). Each request = the dataset's own web-form defaults (national, all ages, all races, both sexes) with the overrides listed per file. The researcher approved the site and agreeing to the WONDER data use terms on 2026-11-06; the I Agree click-through was completed for D74, D76 and D158.
_source.stored: for each query, a verbatim extract of the XML response: the response's own echo of the query (variable-selections, byvariables, measure-selections), the data-table, footnotes and citation; rebuilt by _transcripts/decode_json_extracts.py from _transcripts/wonder_extracts.json, SHA-256 required to match the browser's hash of the extract
_source.measures: M1 deaths, M2 population, M3 crude rate per 100,000 (precision 9 decimals); D158 also returns 95% confidence intervals for the crude rate (M32/M33)
_source.data_use: CDC WONDER data use restrictions (https://wonder.cdc.gov/datause.html): statistical reporting and analysis only; do not publish or present statistics representing nine or fewer deaths (including rates based on them); no attempt to identify individuals or establishments; report any inadvertent identification to the NCHS Confidentiality Officer. Every figure stored here is a national annual total in the thousands. NOTE: the 'homicide' and 'assault' files for 1999-2024 differ only by terrorism homicides (*U01-*U02); outside 2001 those differences are 9 or fewer deaths and must not be published.
_source.citations: see the <citation> element inside each file
_source.pulled: 2026-11-06 (query dates in each file are in WONDER's server time, Nov 7, 2026 ~00:06-00:10)
